title_original: Oscars Predictions 2027: Is ‘You Can See Everything’ the Film That Can Take Down ‘The Odyssey’?

blocks.text: Variety Awards Circuit section is the home for all awards news and related content throughout the year, featuring the following: the official predictions for the upcoming Oscars , Emmys , Grammys and Tony Awards ceremonies, curated by Variety chief awards editor Clayton Davis. The prediction pages reflect the current standings in the race and do not reflect personal preferences for any individual contender. As other formal (and informal) polls suggest, competitions are fluid and subject to change based on buzz and events. Predictions are updated every Thursday.
2027 Academy Awards Predictions Commentary All Categories (Updated: Oct. 15, 2026): Lots of moving pieces as the season treads along.

The New York Film Festival gave the first set of eyes on Luca Guadagnino’s intense dramedy “Artificial,” which could be a major player for Neon, who picked it up after Amazon MGM Studios dumped it earlier in the year. The film could be a force in multiple categories including best picture and supporting actor for Andrew Garfield, who could be the big spoiler if the season breaks his way.

links.text: who could be the big spoiler

blocks.text: NYFF is about to conclude with Ava DuVernay’s documentary feature “14th,” which will have a new original song by Brittany Howard and Robert Glasper.

Other buzzy movies include Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s “You Can See Everything,” which screened at NYFF and in Los Angeles, where it received a rapturous response. As the days continue , it’s looking like we could have our very first nonfiction movie nominated for best picture. Whether or not it makes the ultimate documentary feature shortlist will continue to plague pundits.

Entries for the Golden Globes continue to break around the industry. Mike Leigh’s “Tender Loving Care” will enter the comedy categories , along with Curry Barker’s “Obsession,” which has some on social media scratching their heads.
This week’s updates are below.

The Governors Awards, which will hand out honorary Oscars to Glenn Close and Ridley Scott, will take place Sunday, Nov. 15. Preliminary voting for the Oscars shortlist in 12 categories runs Dec. 7-11, with the shortlist announcement to follow Tuesday, Dec. 15. Following the close of the eligibility period on Dec. 31, 2026, nominations voting will run Jan. 11-15, 2027. The official Oscar nominations will be announced on Thursday, Jan. 21, 2027. The 99th Oscars will take place on Sunday, March 14, 2027 and will be hosted by Conan O’Brien. The ceremony airs live at 7 p.m. ET on ABC and in more than 200 territories worldwide from the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood.
Projected nomination leaders (films) : “The Odyssey” (16); “Dune: Part Three” (11); “La Bola Negra” (10)
Projected nomination leaders (studios) : Universal Pictures (17); A24 and Netflix (14); Warner Bros. (11)
